result.instructions: Tools for ZenHR, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which employees are in the Amman branch, and in which department are they?"; "Show the time-off entries of employee 1159 this year."; "List yesterday's clock-in and clock-out records for my branch.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ZenHR data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zenhr_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zenhr_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zenhr_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. zenhr_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zenhr_who_am_i
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: The token's identity and scopes: which ZenHR data this connection can read. Use it to check the connection.

tools.name: zenhr_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: The company of this ZenHR instance: id, name, country and active flag.

tools.name: zenhr_list_branches
tools.title: List branches
tools.description: The branches (locations or legal entities) of the company, page by page. Branch ids feed the other tools.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). The reply's `pagination` gives the total.

per_page.description: Records per page, 1-100 (default: the API's own default).

tools.name: zenhr_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: The departments of one branch, page by page.

branch_id.description: The branch id (an integer, from zenhr_list_branches).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). The reply's `pagination` gives the total.

per_page.description: Records per page, 1-100 (default: the API's own default).

tools.name: zenhr_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: The employees of one branch, page by page, as ZenHR returns them. Use zenhr_get_employee for one employee.

branch_id.description: The branch id (an integer, from zenhr_list_branches).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). The reply's `pagination` gives the total.

per_page.description: Records per page, 1-100 (default: the API's own default).

tools.name: zenhr_get_employee
tools.title: Get an employee
tools.description: One employee of a branch, by id, as ZenHR returns the record.

branch_id.description: The branch id (an integer, from zenhr_list_branches).

employee_id.description: The employee id (an integer, from zenhr_list_employees).

tools.name: zenhr_get_active_professional_data
tools.title: Get active job record
tools.description: The job record that is active now for one employee: position, department, site, manager and effective dates.

branch_id.description: The branch id (an integer, from zenhr_list_branches).

employee_id.description: The employee id (an integer, from zenhr_list_employees).

tools.name: zenhr_list_timeoffs
tools.title: List time-off types
tools.description: The time-off types (leave policies) of one branch, page by page.

branch_id.description: The branch id (an integer, from zenhr_list_branches).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). The reply's `pagination` gives the total.

per_page.description: Records per page, 1-100 (default: the API's own default).

tools.name: zenhr_list_timeoff_transactions
tools.title: List time-off entries
tools.description: Time-off entries (days taken, added or adjusted) of one branch, or of one employee when employee_id is given. Page by page.

branch_id.description: The branch id (an integer, from zenhr_list_branches).

employee_id.description: The employee id (an integer, from zenhr_list_employees).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). The reply's `pagination` gives the total.

per_page.description: Records per page, 1-100 (default: the API's own default).

tools.title: List attendance records
tools.description: Clock-in and clock-out records of one branch, between two dates (inclusive), page by page.

branch_id.description: The branch id (an integer, from zenhr_list_branches).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). The reply's `pagination` gives the total.

per_page.description: Records per page, 1-100 (default: the API's own default).
